verdict.rationale: Sentry ingests both OpenTelemetry traces and logs through OTLP endpoints, and its Trace Explorer lets you explore span samples and attributes, so the pieces for trace-plus-log debugging exist in one platform. However, no evidence shows navigating from a specific span to its correlated logs or metrics. Seer Agent 'finding the right telemetry' only implies some cross-signal correlation. Missing for 10: documented span-to-log navigation/correlation, metrics correlation from spans, end-to-end request debugging workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
